request: Build a small Jac web app for booking meeting rooms. A booking has a room, a start and an end time on a day. A new or moved booking is accepted only if it does not overlap another booking in the same room. Users can ask for a room's free slots within business hours.
acceptance: 10:00-11:00 does not conflict with 11:00-12:00 (end is exclusive) but conflicts with 10:59-11:30.
Moving a booking to a time that overlaps only its own old time is accepted.
With business hours 9-17 and bookings 9-10 and 13-14, the free slots are exactly 10-13 and 14-17.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
